Diagnosis.submission: The mongodb-rate and mongodb-geo deployments are in CrashLoopBackOff because their MongoDB image was changed from mongo:4.4.6 to mongo:8.0.14-rc0. The existing data on the PersistentVolumeClaims was written by MongoDB 4.4 (featureCompatibilityVersion: 4.4), which is incompatible with MongoDB 8.0 that requires featureCompatibilityVersion >= 7.0. MongoDB cannot be upgraded across multiple major versions directly (4.4 -> 8.0 skips required intermediate versions). Both services (geo and rate) that depend on these MongoDB instances are therefore unable to connect to their databases, degrading the hotel reservation application.
